question: Which background/quadratic statements remain source-locked over the full unresolved HMT universal-matter interface family, and can RTK pole/residue/remainder equivalence be certified without selecting a representative interface?
decision_rule: FULL_INVARIANT requires source-lock of the same-action background carrier, finite-k denominator/kernel, and response source/numerator over the entire surviving universal-matter family. INTERFACE_DEPENDENT applies if independently fixed intrinsic P(X) identities survive but at least one scalar-response observable required by the old RTK certificate (in particular residue/source normalization, or the denominator through auxiliary couplings) changes with an unfixed interface parameter. No representative coupling point may be chosen.
exact_witness: For a fixed inverse denominator D(z) and two allowed source normalizations c1 != c2, R_c(z)=c^2/D(z). The finite pole can remain identical while the residue scales as c^2. Thus unresolved source normalization alone is sufficient to prevent unique pole+residue+remainder equivalence certification.
required_guards: Z12 Z15 Z16 Z17 classifications exact
do not promote intrinsic carrier coefficients to a full response source map
do not choose a representative HMT matter-interface point
